[heading][center][size=6]Meet M.I.N.E.R.[/size][/center]
[center][size=6][youtube]lxlZABa-EBI[/youtube][/size][/center]
[/heading]
The Mobile Integrated Navigation & Excavation Robot is a small robotic companion who joins you on your mining adventures.
Bring him along and he'll help clear nearby rocks and ore, follow you between mine floors, and work alongside you as you explore. When the day is done, bring him home to his [b]Charging Station[/b], upgrade his equipment with Maru's help, and maybe take a little time to talk to him.
After all, there might be more on his mind than the next rock.
[heading][center][size=5]Main Features[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[/heading]
[list]
[*]⛏️ [b]Mining Companion[/b] — Bring M.I.N.E.R. into the  Mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry Mine, and Volcano Dungeon.[/*]
[*][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791350934-1592874367.png[/img] Charging Station[/b] — Give M.I.N.E.R. his own place on your farm to rest, recharge, and wait for your next adventure.[/*]
[*]🔧 [b]Upgradeable Equipment[/b] — Improve his Drill, Thrusters, Energy Capacity, and Efficiency as you progress.[/*]
[*][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791350891-649119593.png[/img] Project Notebook[/b] — Work with Maru on new upgrades and use the notebook to keep track of projects and required materials.[/*]
[*]💬 [b]Friendship & Personality[/b] — Talk with M.I.N.E.R. and get to know the little robot you've brought home.[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]20 Story Events[/b] — Discover new scenes as your friendship grows and M.I.N.E.R. becomes more than just a mining machine.[/*]
[*]👥 [b]Multiplayer Support[/b] — Your farm shares one M.I.N.E.R. and his upgrades, while each player builds their own friendship with him.[/*]
[/list]M.I.N.E.R.'s mining works with Stardew Valley's [b]native drops and ladder system[/b], so rocks he destroys behave naturally while he's mining alongside you.

[/heading]
You [b]do not need to start a new save.[/b] M.I.N.E.R. can be discovered naturally on an existing farm.
Start by exploring the [b]regular Mines[/b] and keep an eye out for anything unusual. If you find something interesting, investigate it and then pay Maru a visit.
Once M.I.N.E.R. has been repaired, you'll receive his [b]Charging Station[/b]. Place it somewhere on your main farm with at least one clear tile beside it.
From there, just talk to M.I.N.E.R. whenever you want to bring him along on a mining trip.
Can't Find Him?
M.I.N.E.R. is intended to be discovered naturally but If you're stuck, or just don't want to hunt for him, the included [b]Player Guide[/b] contains a discovery hint. (I'll be honest though, he's hard to miss...)
The guide also includes full upgrade requirements and progression details for players who prefer to know exactly what they're working toward and how.

[spoiler][b][size=6]M.I.N.E.R.  1.0.0 player guide[/size][/b]

[b]What is M.I.N.E.R.?[/b]

M.I.N.E.R. is a little robot with a talent for mining and plenty to learn about life outside the Mines. Discover him while exploring, get him working again with Maru's help, and take him along on your mining trips. As you work together, you can improve his equipment and get to know him through conversations and small Story scenes.


[b]Getting Started[/b]

Keep an eye out while exploring the regular Mines. When you find something unusual, investigate it and speak with Maru. She can help you put the pieces together.

After the repair, place the Charging Station outdoors on your main farm. Leave a clear, walkable tile beside it for M.I.N.E.R. to rest and take off. Keep just one Station placed on the farm so he has an unambiguous home. Leave inventory room when beginning the repair so you can receive the Station.

You do not need to start a new save.


Optional discovery hint 

Look around [b]floor 20 of the regular Mines[/b].


[b][size=4]Using M.I.N.E.R.[/size][/b]

Walk near him and use the game's action button. With a mouse, click on the robot; with a keyboard or controller, face him and interact as you would with other nearby objects.

At home, choose the option to bring him mining, then head to a supported mining floor. Give him a moment to arrive. Before travelling, you can cancel the deployment if your plans change.

[b]While you are out together[/b]:

[left][list]
[*][b]Check Charge[/b] tells you how much Energy he has left.[/*]
[*][b]Standby[/b] pauses his mining. He can still follow you.[/*]
[*][b]Resume Mining[/b] sends him back to work.[/*]
[*][b]Use Battery Pack[/b] appears when he can use a recharge and you can consume one to fully replenish his energy.[/*]
[/list][/left]

He follows your trip between supported floors and returns toward his farm home when that trip ends. Regular Mines, Skull Cavern, Quarry Mine and the Volcano Dungeon are supported mining areas. He can also travel into Caldera so the trip doesn't get interrupted when you get there.

At home, use [b]Talk with M.I.N.E.R.[/b] for a check-in (Some events require a certain amount of check-ins to become available, so check in on the little guy). [b]Something on your mind?[/b] appears when an eligible conversation is available. A missing topic is often a matter of timing or progress. Conversations and events unfold as you spend time together

[b][size=4]Charging, Energy and Battery Packs[/size][/b]

Hitting targets uses M.I.N.E.R.'s Energy. Check his charge before a longer trip, especially if you expect him to do a lot of work.

One ordinary [b]Battery Pack[/b] restores his charge to its current maximum. The pack is consumed when used. His charge also replenishes overnight. Capacity upgrades give him a larger reserve, while Efficiency upgrades reduce the cost of his mining strikes.

[b][size=4]Upgrades[/size]
[/b]
Maru can improve four parts of M.I.N.E.R.:

[left][list]
[*][b]Drill[/b]: stronger mining equipment, with later tiers allowing tougher targets. Each tier is roughly equivalent to the same upgrade tree of pickaxes. The last one is stronger.[/*]
[*][b]Thruster[/b]: better movement speed.[/*]
[*][b]Capacity[/b]: more Energy to work with.[/*]
[*][b]Efficiency[/b]: less Energy spent on mining strikes.[/*]
[/list][/left]

New projects become available as M.I.N.E.R. reaches mining milestones and spends time working with you. Check the Project Notebook for the parts required and speak to Maru about available work. The Notebook shows what you need

 [size=5][b]Project Notebook and Maru
[/b][/size]
After the repair, Maru sends the Project Notebook to the player who initiated it the next day. Place and open it to review projects, required parts and what you currently have available. Speak to Maru to follow up on the work.

In multiplayer, other eligible players also learn the Notebook recipe, including players who join later. You can craft more Notebooks with [b]10 Wood and 5 Fiber[/b]; multiple physical books are fine.

[b][size=5]Multiplayer[/size][/b]

Your farm has [b]one shared M.I.N.E.R.[/b] Any eligible player can bring him along, but he travels with only one player at a time. Everyone shares his repairs, equipment and mining accomplishments. The player who pays for a project supplies the required materials from their inventory.

Your friendship is your own. Check-ins, personal conversations, event history and M.I.N.E.R.'s way of addressing you belong to each player separately. A player joining an established farm get's his own history that starts over from scratch

Personal Story scenes don't interrupt other players and multiple people can initiate their own events at the same time. If the player travelling with M.I.N.E.R. disconnects, that assignment ends safely and he will return back to his home station. Rejoining does not automatically take him back from another player, deploy him again when he is available.

All players need the same mod version. [b][u]Split-screen is not supported in 1.0.0.!![/u][/b]

[size=6][b][u]Troubleshooting[/u][/b][/size]

[b]M.I.N.E.R. is missing from home:[/b] check that one Charging Station is placed on your farm, with clear walkable space beside it. Remove obstructions and make sure someone else has not already taken him out.

[b]He has not arrived underground:[/b] enter a supported mining floor and allow time for the him to arrive. The player who took him is the player he follows.

[b]The repair or an upgrade cannot begin[/b]: check the requested materials and inventory room. Speak to Maru and consult the Notebook for the current project.

[b]A conversation is unavailable:[/b] check in another time. Some conversations need more shared progress, more time together or a particular setting.

[b]Multiplayer is behaving differently between players[/b]: first check that everyone has the same M.I.N.E.R. version. Then collect a log from the affected player and Host if possible.

[b]Maru isn't saying anything about M.I.N.E.R.![/b]: Vanilla and modd'ed dialogue supersede M.I.N.E.R.'s. Exhaust the current pool of interactions with Maru and then approach her again with another action command. If that didn't work, she may simply have nothing to say right now or an upgrade hasn't been discovered by miner yet. This was done this way mainly for compatibility, since I cant possibly guess every mod people will have.

Keep a save backup. Do not delete mod save data or reset your progress to troubleshoot an ordinary installation problem. I can then use the backup save to try and reproduce whatever bug you are experiencing.

[b][size=6][u]Bug Reports and Developer Diagnostics[/u][/size][/b]

[u]Please include your game, SMAPI and M.I.N.E.R. versions;[/u] whether you were in single-player, Host or farmhand; what you did; what you expected; and what happened. [b][u]Include the SMAPI log[/u][/b] from that session and the relevant mod list. A screenshot or short clip helps with visual issues.

M.I.N.E.R.'s developer tools and routine diagnostic logging are [b]off by default[/b]. Real warnings and errors remain visible. If asked to gather more information, type these into the SMAPI console:

miner_dev_tools on
miner_dev_overlay off

The first command enables local diagnostics and prints the loaded build identity. The second hides the path/target overlay while leaving logging available. Safe status commands include `miner_persistence_status`, `miner_station_status`, `miner_progression_status` and `miner_story_personal_status` when requested.

To turn diagnostics off again:

miner_dev_tools off


Returning to the title screen keeps the setting; restarting the game starts with the tools off again. Help entries may remain after disabling, but their commands cannot run until you enable tools again.

[b]Use status commands for a report.[/b] Progress-reset, item-grant and event-preparation commands are development tools and are not needed for ordinary play. A backed-up save may be requested for a specific issue; do not send one automatically if the log and reproduction already explain the problem.[/spoiler]
[/center]

Use SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.  Stardew Valley 1.6.15, No other mods are required.

[b]Manual Installation:[/b]
Close the game and extract the `MinerBot` folder into `Mods`. Start through SMAPI. Multiplayer players should all use the same mod version.

[b]Automatic Installation: [/b]
Vortex can be used to automatically add the mod to an available profile.

[b]Manual Updates:[/b]
For updates, back up your save and old mod folder, move/delete the old folder out of `Mods`, and install the complete new download. Keep your save data and progress.

[b]Automatic Updates:[/b]
Vortex can be used to update the mod as well.


[center][size=4][b]Sharing the farm[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425441-1068171006.png[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425441-1068171006.png[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425441-1068171006.png[/img] [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425441-1068171006.png[/img] [/center]

Anyone can take M.I.N.E.R. out, but he travels with one player at a time. Repairs, upgrades and his mining accomplishments belong to the farm. Whoever pays for an upgrade provides the materials.

Your conversations and Story history belong to you. Another player's event completion or seen events shouldn't interfere with anyone else. Players joining later can form their own friendship without resetting M.I.N.E.R. or inheriting anyone's personal Story history.

[center][/center]
[center][b][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425705-1883557298.png[/img] Compatibility and limitations [img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425705-1883557298.png[/img] [/size][/b]
[/center]

Single-player and a Host with two farmhand's have been tested. Those multiplayer tests only used one computer though. Network play should still work the same way, if not please submit a bug report.

[b][u]Split-screen is unsupported in 1.0.0. [/u][/b]Custom farms should be supported. There is no promise that every map, mine, NPC or Content Patcher overhaul will work. I tested things in a heavily modd'ed game too though, roughly 218 mods including SVE, East Scarp and more. M.I.N.E.R. stays near his Station at home currently.

In multiplayer, certain vanilla mining paths can use the Host's luck and credit some native statistics to the Host. Seemed like a small tradeoff for compatibility.

Obviously I couldn't test every last scenario. So I'm looking forward to seeing people break the game in ways I could never imagine. I'll plan to implement bug fixes regularly as they come in and in batches.

[center][size=4][b]Need help?[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53525/53525-1791425393-763883338.png[/img][/center]

Check that M.I.N.E.R. has one placed Station with clear nearby ground, that another player has not already deployed him, and that you have any required materials and inventory room. Some conversations need a different time or more progress.

For a bug report, include your versions, mod list, SP/Host/farmhand role, reproduction steps and SMAPI log. Developer tools are off by default. If needed I might ask for diagnostics, use `miner_dev_tools on`; use `miner_dev_overlay off` to collect logs without the path overlay, and `miner_dev_tools off` when finished. A fresh game process starts with tools off. Avoid progress-reset or preparation commands for ordinary troubleshooting.

[center][size=4][b]Community add-ons and permissions[/b][/size][/center]

Please feel free to create and publish add-ons: content packs, compatibility patches, translations, integrations, dialogue, events, alternate portraits/sprites, balance changes and other extensions that work with M.I.N.E.R. Individual permission is not needed for an add-on. Credit and a link to the original mod are appreciated.

Make the original M.I.N.E.R. a dependency where appropriate. Do not bundle or redistribute its DLL or original asset files without permission. Do not reupload the complete mod or publish a repackaged edition without permission.
